mapper.sql: ar.paper_id AS paperId, p.title AS paperTitle, p.total_score AS maxScore, ar.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.nickname, SUM(ar.score) AS totalScore, SUM(ar.correct = 1) AS correctCount, SUM(ar.correct = 0 AND ar.chosen IS NOT NULL) AS wrongCount, SUM(ar.chosen IS NULL) AS blankCount, COUNT(*) AS questionCount, ROUND(SUM(ar.correct = 1) / COUNT(*), 2) AS accuracy, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(ar.submitted_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS submittedAt
GROUP BY ar.paper_id, ar.user_id, p.title, p.total_score, u.username, u.nickname
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM answer_record ar JOIN exam_paper p ON p.id = ar.paper_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ar.user_id
AND ar.paper_id = #{paperId}
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY ar.paper_id, totalScore DESC, ar.user_id

SELECT
FROM answer_record ar JOIN exam_paper p ON p.id = ar.paper_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ar.user_id WHERE ar.paper_id = #{paperId} AND ar.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT pq.seq, ar.question_id AS questionId, q.type, q.stem, ar.chosen AS chosenJson, q.answer AS answerJson, ar.correct, ar.score FROM answer_record ar JOIN exam_paper_question pq ON pq.paper_id = ar.paper_id AND pq.question_id = ar.question_id JOIN question q ON q.id = ar.question_id WHERE ar.paper_id = #{paperId} AND ar.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY pq.seq

SELECT ar.user_id AS userId, u.nickname, SUM(ar.score) AS totalScore FROM answer_record ar JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ar.user_id WHERE ar.paper_id = #{paperId} GROUP BY ar.user_id, u.nickname ORDER BY totalScore DESC, ar.user_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT SUM(ar.correct = 1) AS correctSum, SUM(ar.correct = 0) AS wrongSum, SUM(ar.chosen IS NULL) AS blankSum, COUNT(*) AS answeredSum FROM answer_record ar
